info.title: Botmother Universal API
info.description: Trigger Botmother external events to launch a configured bot screen or message for platform users, Botmother users, or everyone.

post.summary: Trigger External Event For Botmother Users
post.description: Triggers an external event in Botmother for users by bm_id.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

data.description: Optional JSON payload copied into last_request.

limits.description: Botmother queue limit summary returned with the request.

exceeded.description: Whether Botmother reports that queue limits were exceeded.

queued.description: Number of events queued in each Botmother queue tier.

big.description: Count queued in the big Botmother processing queue.

small.description: Count queued in the small Botmother processing queue.

remained.description: Remaining Botmother queue capacity after this request.

big.description: Remaining capacity in the big Botmother processing queue.

small.description: Remaining capacity in the small Botmother processing queue.

__v.description: Botmother internal version number for the queued event record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when Botmother created the queued event record.

errorCount.description: Number of delivery errors currently recorded for the queued event.

items.description: Provider-reported event processing errors, when present.

partitionsWasCreated.description: Whether Botmother created queue partitions for the event.

processedCount.description: Number of deliveries processed so far for the queued event.

queryOptions.description: Resolved audience filters used by Botmother for this event.

botId.description: Botmother bot id that owns the external event.

items.description: Excluded Botmother audience tags.
Resolved channel-specific platform user ids included in the event audience.
Target platforms resolved by Botmother.
Resolved Botmother user ids included in the event audience.
Included Botmother audience tags.

sendData.description: Event delivery payload Botmother will send to the matching users.

items.description: Attachment objects included in the outgoing event, when present.

data.description: Custom data payload Botmother will place into last_request.

formatedMessage.description: Botmother-formatted message body, when returned by the provider.

message.description: Message body used by the event when the target type sends a message.

screen.description: Target Botmother screen name configured for the event.

stopDialog.description: Whether Botmother will close the current dialog before delivering the event.

type.description: Configured Botmother target type for the event, such as screen.

shard.description: Botmother internal shard identifier for the queued event.

status.description: Current Botmother processing status for the queued event.

successCount.description: Number of successful deliveries currently recorded for the queued event.

totalCount.description: Total number of matching audience records considered by Botmother.

type.description: Botmother record type returned for the queued event.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when Botmother last updated the queued event record.

result.description: True when Botmother accepts the external event request.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
